extract_features_from_images: extract features from a list of augmented images using the detector's extract_feats method
train_detector_model: run a training step on the detector model by calling train_step with batch data and optimizer
test_detector_with_augmentation: test the detector model with test-time augmentation using forward_test with multiple image augmentations
visualize_detection_results: draw bounding boxes and segmentation masks over an image using show_result with configurable colors and thresholds
parse_and_reduce_losses: parse raw network loss outputs and reduce them across GPUs for distributed training using _parse_losses
